mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_sessions (id, customer_id, access_token_hash, access_expires_at, refresh_expires_at, device_label, user_agent, created_ip, last_ip, created_at, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{accessHash}, #{accessExpiresAt}, #{refreshExpiresAt}, #{deviceLabel}, #{userAgent}, CAST(#{ip} AS inet), CAST(#{ip} AS inet), #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO customer_refresh_tokens (id, session_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{tokenHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.customer_id, s.access_expires_at, s.revoked_at, s.step_up_at, s.last_seen_at, c.status AS customer_status, c.preferred_language AS language FROM customer_sessions s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE s.access_token_hash = #{accessHash}

SELECT rt.id AS token_id, rt.session_id, s.customer_id, rt.expires_at, rt.consumed_at, s.revoked_at AS session_revoked_at, s.refresh_expires_at AS session_refresh_expires_at, c.status AS customer_status FROM customer_refresh_tokens rt JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.id = rt.session_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE rt.token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE OF rt, s
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_refresh_tokens SET consumed_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{tokenId}

UPDATE customer_sessions SET access_token_hash = #{accessHash}, access_expires_at = #{accessExpiresAt}, refresh_expires_at = #{refreshExpiresAt}, last_seen_at = #{now}, last_ip = CAST(#{ip} AS inet) WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE customer_sessions SET last_seen_at = #{now}, last_ip = CAST(#{ip} AS inet) WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND last_seen_at < #{threshold}
UPDATE customer_sessions SET step_up_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE customer_sessions SET revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_label, created_at, last_seen_at FROM customer_sessions WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND refresh_expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC
